MDD analysis

0. Setup

library(BrainEnrich)
library(stringr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(enrichplot)

data_path='E:/xhmhc/BrainEnrich_ms/data'
code_path='E:/xhmhc/BrainEnrich_ms/code'
fun_path='E:/xhmhc/BrainEnrich_ms/code/functions'
res_path='E:/xhmhc/BrainEnrich_ms/results'
if (!dir.exists(res_path)){dir.create(res_path, showWarnings = FALSE)}

1. Prepare Data for the Analysis

1.1. Load brain_data

df=read.csv(file.path(data_path,'MP_data.csv')) %>% dplyr::filter(str_detect(label,'L_'))
str(df)

1.2. Create/Load perm_id for the Analysis

# coord.l=read.csv(file.path(data_path, 'desikan_centroid.csv')) %>% dplyr::select("centroid1", "centroid2", "centroid3") %>% as.matrix()
# perm_id=rotate_parcellation(coord.l=coord.l, nrot=5000, seed=2024)
# saveRDS(perm_id, file.path(data_path,'perm_id_dk_lh_5000.RDS'))
perm_id=readRDS(file.path(data_path,'perm_id_dk_lh_5000.RDS'))

1.3. Load gene expression data for the Analysis

gene_data=get_geneExp(atlas='desikan', rdonor='r0.4',hem='L')
str(gene_data)
##  num [1:34, 1:6513] 0.469 0.607 0.512 0.341 0.664 ...
##  - attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
##   ..$ : chr [1:34] "L_bankssts" "L_caudalanteriorcingulate" "L_caudalmiddlefrontal" "L_cuneus" ...
##   ..$ : chr [1:6513] "A1BG" "A1BG-AS1" "AACS" "AADAT" ...

1.4. Load GO MF for the Analysis

annot2analysis='GO_MF'
annoData=get_annoData(type=annot2analysis)
geneSetList=get_geneSetList(annoData)
length(geneSetList)
## [1] 5060
print(sprintf('Number of MF terms: %d',length(geneSetList)))
## [1] "Number of MF terms: 5060"

1.5. Filter the geneSetList

This step is embedded in the brainenrich function. Here is just to show how it is filtered.

selected.gs=filter_geneSetList(bg_genes=colnames(gene_data), geneSetList=geneSetList, minGSSize=20, maxGSSize=200)
print(sprintf('%d terms have gene size ranging between 20 and 200',length(selected.gs)))

2. Run the Analysis

2.1. Prepare mdd data for the Analysis

brain_data.mdd=df %>% dplyr::select(label, MDD) %>% dplyr::filter(str_detect(label,'L_')) %>% tibble::column_to_rownames('label')
head(brain_data.mdd)
##                              MDD
## L_bankssts                -0.058
## L_caudalanteriorcingulate -0.042
## L_caudalmiddlefrontal     -0.014
## L_cuneus                   0.047
## L_entorhinal              -0.041
## L_fusiform                -0.117

show effect size map for mdd

source(file.path(fun_path,'plot_brain.R'))
df2plot.mdd=df %>% dplyr::select(label, MDD) %>%  dplyr::rename(label=label, statistic=MDD)
p=plot_brain(df2plot.mdd,ats='dk',filterby = 'none',limit2show=c(-0.3,0.3), 
        what2plot = 'statistic',hem='left',low='#0197b2',mid='white',high='orange',
        legend2show = 'Effect Size')
# ggsave(file.path(res_path,'mdd_effect_size_map.png'), p, width=8, height=6, bg='transparent')
print(p)

2.2. Run the Analysis

res=brainenrich(brain_data=brain_data.mdd, 
                    gene_data=gene_data, 
                    annoData = annoData, 
                    perm_id=perm_id, 
                    cor_method = 'pearson',
                    aggre_method = 'mean',
                    null_model = 'spin_brain',
                    n_perm=5000, 
                    n_cores=0,
                    minGSSize = 20, 
                    maxGSSize = 200,
                    pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
df.res=as.data.frame(res)
# saveRDS(res, file.path(res_path,'mdd_MF_res.RDS'))

3. Visualize the Results

3.1. Upset Plot

upsetplot(res, top=10)

3.2. Gene-Concept Network

p=cnetplot(res, layout='kk', color_category='#a6a6a6', foldChange=geneList,
          # color.params = list(foldChange = geneList),
          showtext=TRUE,
          node_label = 'gene',
          showCategory =10, cex.params = list(category_node=1, gene_node=0.8, gene_label=0.8),
          shadowtext = 'category')
p=p+scale_color_gradient2(midpoint=0,low='#0197b2',mid='white',high='orange',
                         space ="Lab" ,limits = c(-1,1), name='Association')
#ggsave(file.path(res_path,'mdd_MF_cnetplot.png'), p, width=6, height=4, bg='white')
print(p)

3.3. Dot Plot

p=dotplot(res,x=~gsScore,label_format=25, showCategory=10)
p=p+xlab('GS score')+scale_fill_gradient(high='#ffffff',low='orange',
                         space ="Lab" , name='p.adjusted',limits = c(0,0.05)) +
                         theme(legend.position = 'none')
#ggsave(file.path(res_path,'mdd_MF_dotplot_nolegend.png'), p, width=5, height=6, bg='transparent',units='in')
print(p)

3.4. Heatplot with dot

p=heatplot(res, foldChange = geneList, label_format = 50, showCategory = 10, symbol="dot") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0, low = "#0197b2", mid = "grey", high = "orange",
    space = "Lab", limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Association"
  )

#ggsave(file.path(res_path,'mdd_MF_heatplot1.png'), p, width=10, height=6, bg='white')
print(p)

3.5. Heatplot with grey

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


showCategory = 10
  # Filter and rank the results by p.adjust < 0.05 and gsScore
df2plot <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    head(showCategory) %>% 
    arrange(desc(gsScore))%>%
    mutate(Description=factor(Description, levels=unique(Description))) %>%
    mutate(gene = strsplit(core_enrichment, "/")) %>%
    unnest(gene) %>%
    select(gene, ID, Description) %>%
    mutate(association = res@geneList[.$gene])


code_path='E:/xhmhc/BrainEnrich_ms/code'
source(file.path(code_path,'functions/plot_helpers.R'))
  # Plot the heatmap
p=ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = gene, y = Description)) +
  geom_rtile(radius = unit(1.4, "mm"), color = "white", alpha = 0.8, fill='grey') + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(df2plot$Description)))+  # Add a border to tiles
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,color='black'),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
#ggsave(file.path(res_path,'mdd_MF_heatplot_test1.png'), p, width=8.1, height=6, bg='transparent')
print(p)

3.6. Heatplot with filled color

p=ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = gene, y = Description, fill=association)) +
  geom_rtile(radius = unit(1.4, "mm"), color = "white", alpha = 1) + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(df2plot$Description)))+  # Add a border to tiles
    scale_fill_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0, low = "#0197b2", mid = "white", high = "orange",
    space = "Lab", limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Association"
  )+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,color='black'),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
#ggsave(file.path(res_path,'mdd_MF_heatplot_filled.png'), p, width=8.1, height=6, bg='transparent')
print(p)

3.7. Treeplot

library(ggplot2)
d <- GOSemSim::godata(annoDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", ont = "MF", keytype = "SYMBOL", computeIC = FALSE) # computeIC=FALSE when use Wang method
res <- pairwise_termsim(res, method = "Wang", semData = d)
p=treeplot(res,
  showCategory = 30,
  fontsize=4,
  cex_category = 0.9, color = "p.adjust",
  cluster.params = list( n = 5,label_words_n = 3,
  color = c("#FFB14ECC",  "#89be95cc","#8dc4d2", "#99bed3cc", "#ef9d8bcc")),
  offset = rel(2)
) + scale_color_continuous(high = "white", low = "orange",
    space = "Lab",  name = "gsScore"
  )+
theme(legend.position = 'right') 
#ggsave(file.path(res_path,'mdd_MF_treeplot.png'), p, width=16, height=9, bg='transparent')
print(p)
